dominant_strengths: Confident monospaced wordmark with lime status dot establishes a clear technical, studio-grade identity in the header
Restrained dark palette with single chartreuse accent creates focused hierarchy between active nav, inactive links, and CTA
Nav spacing and active-state weight contrast read cleanly; the Contact pill is appropriately differentiated from text links
dominant_weaknesses: Page is essentially empty with a 'page_content_here' placeholder, so judgment rests almost entirely on a thin header bar
No micro-interactions, hover affordances, underlines, or motion cues are visible to convey behavioral richness
Layout is generic top-bar nav with no distinctive structural idea, breakpoint logic, or system signal beyond the dot
fix_priorities: Replace the placeholder with real hero content so navigation is judged in context of a composed page
Add hover/active micro-states (underline sweep, dot migration to active item) to elevate motion and craft
Introduce a secondary structural element—section index, breadcrumb, or progress rail—to make the nav system distinctive
Tighten right-edge alignment and optical balance between Journal and the Contact pill padding
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity slightly outweighs a muted visceral hit, while reflective depth is weak because the page has no narrative beyond a placeholder.
rationale.intent_fit: It satisfies the literal navigation brief with a legible top bar, but offers no distinctive navigational concept beyond a conventional studio header.
